info.title: Open-Meteo Geocoding
info.description: A hand-written subset of Open-Meteo's geocoding API (keyless, read-only), for config/agents/examples/weather.yaml. Docs: https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/geocoding-api

get.summary: Find a place by name. Returns matching places with their latitude, longitude, country and timezone; the first result is the most likely.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The place name, e.g. Lyon or Lyon, France.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: How many matches to return (1-10). Use 3.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language of the names returned, e.g. en.
